DSH productivity suite: plugins + agent skills for the DeepSeek Harness, installable in one command.
# dsh-suite
Plugins and agent skills for DSH, installable in one command. After a restart of the harness, the pr
ofile has virtual model ids with automatic failover, cold-start project context in every new session
, and nine agent skills wired in — routes and credentials stay yours.
## What's inside
| Piece | Type | What it does |
| `dsh-model-router` | plugin | Virtual model ids routed over real provider/model candidates — prior

ity failover, round-robin rotation, sleep windows |
| `deep-horizon` | plugin | Injects the project'
s horizon (open gaps + about line) into every new session — cold-start project context shared across

harnesses |
| strong-orchestrator | skill | Sequential implement → review-loop orchestration with a

persistent implementer |
| dex / dex-plan | skills | Task hierarchies: epics, subtasks, verificatio

n via the dex CLI |
| ponytail (+ audit, debt, gain, help, review) | skills | Lazy-senior-dev output
style family: shortest working diff wins |
Standalone siblings that don't ride in this bundle: archloop (overnight architecture-improvement loo
p driver) and hkrc (Hermes Kanban blocker recovery controller).
## Install
Requires a DSH profile to install into:

That command installs this package, pulls the plugin dependencies (`@andrepontesmelo/dsh-model-route
r` and `deep-horizon`), and registers the bundle patch, which points DSH skill discovery at the nine
bundled skills. Restart the harness and every suite piece is live in that profile.
Both dependencies are pinned to release tags (`deep-horizon#v0.2.0`, `@andrepontesmelo/dsh-model-rou
ter#v0.2.1`), so what an install pulls cannot drift between installs — pin your install the same way
(tag) rather than floating on a branch. This bundle registers nine agent skills into the target pro
file; audit a bundle you did not write before installing it.
